programme.desc: After a compulsive gambler's wife leaves him, he gets offered a beautiful ghost as his new wife.

programme.title: Come Drink With Me
programme.desc: King Hu's groundbreaking film set the foundation for all his action films that followed, most notably Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon.

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: A singer struggles against the odds to keep her career and marriage intact. Starring Jenny Hu, Peter Chen Ho.

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: It's Shaolin versus corrupt Ching soldiers in Chang Cheh's fun-filled kung-fu showcase, filled with show-stopping martial arts sequences.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: After Ah Niu moves to Hong Kong, a kind-hearted fellow from rural China is taken advantage by cunning characters including his uncle.

programme.title: Journey of the Doomed
programme.desc: A swordsman bids to protect a beautiful princess while being stalked by a bunch of assassins. Starring Tung Wei, Kara Hui.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: One of the most enjoyable musicals to grace the Hong Kong screen, this classic stars the husband-and-wife team of Peter Chen and Betty Loh.

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: A Shaw kung fu classic from 1984, this film depicts the trials of a young hero who sets out to avenge his parents' death.

programme.title: Return of the Dead
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang's dark offering depicts the destructive effects of lust as narrated by three psychiatric patients in an asylum.

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: First a hero and then his daughter try to protect Ming Emperor Jianwen infant son from rebels headed by Tien Fung.

programme.title: Opium and the Kung-Fu Master
programme.desc: Legendary kung fu choreographer Tang Chia's last work is one of the greatest ever, and one of Shaw Brothers' finest movies ever produced.

programme.title: Sweet and Wild
programme.desc: With a twisted plot, mistaken identities, along with some terrific musical numbers, this comedy of errors featuring Li Ching is absolutely fabulous.

programme.title: Martial Club
programme.desc: Wong Fei Hung (Gordon Liu) fights for balance in the martial world with the evil Lu school and a northern master in their employ.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Follow a virtuous viper as it sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a dangerous lady in this thriller!

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: The retired one-armed swordsman made his reappearance to fight against the brutal robbers and protect the peace of the martial art world.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Featuring the unforgettable song Country Road, Shaw's Huangmei Opera stars Ivy Ling Po and tells the tale of a poor student engaged to a billionaire's daughter.

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: At first, a gang just wants the village locksmith to open a stolen safe, but it soon escalates into wholesale torment when they are met with resistance.

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this sequel, the Mad Monk is joined by immortal scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin, as they both wreak havoc in an attempt to outdo each other!

programme.title: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A corrupt official's obsessive bid to find a hidden treasure leads him to jail and torture his daughter's lover, and bury her alive!

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: This three-film anthology collectively offers up a captivating examination of human obsession and love.

programme.title: Swift Sword
programme.desc: Director Ho Meng-hua presents an all-star cast in this searing martial arts extravaganza that will bewitch you with its swift swordplay.

programme.title: Whose Baby Is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Inoue Umetsugu's last Shaw film before his untimely death is a testament to the auteur's carefree comic talent.

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by 'Drunken Master', this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist who creates a cricket-style fighting technique to defeat the pugilists who bested him before.

programme.title: Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: In this classic, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu take on Shaw's first international superstar, Lo Lieh, making this a 4-star treat for action fans.

programme.title: The Lady Is the Boss
programme.desc: A martial arts sifu and a hip marketing wiz have to overlook their differences to outsmart gangsters who are trying to take them down.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: When deadbeats Ming and Liang stumble upon records of scandals involving government officials, what follows is a humorous misadventure of epic proportions.

programme.title: The Imperial Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: The story revolves around a maverick, a band of female warriors and a group of ruthless bandits who teams up to raid the emperor's tomb. Will they be successful?

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: Starring Kara Hui, Yuen Tak and Meng Yuen Man, this film depicts a series of battles as everyone fights over the 'Yuan Yang Swords', which hold the secrets to Kung Fu.

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin
programme.desc: Two rebel Shaolin warriors embark on a deadly secret mission aimed at bringing down the Ching Dynasty. Starring Lo Meng, Chin Siu Ho.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Serio-comic clashes of cultures ensue when a Mainland Chinese family try to make a go of it in Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: This actioner revolves around the conflicts of kung fu masters. Complications further ensue when one of them falls for a princess.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: The Shaw Brothers' directors created this 60's classic depicting a timeless romance between a wealthy man and a songbird.

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: Veteran Yueh Feng made this 'Martial Arts World' saga of a masked master of the 'Black Sand Hand Technique,' starring Lily Ho in a dual role.

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: When Fang returns from the U.S. to see Rose but starts eyeing her old friend's fiance, Rose shows that she has a thorny side.

programme.title: Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are saved by Master Lian during a botched exorcism and they beseech him to teach them. Then his friend is killed and with his master's help, Lu avenges him.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: This epic depicts the romance between the Jade Emperor's seventh daughter and a young village man. When Heaven and Earth meet, can a common ground be found?

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: A detective's son's attempt to punish a swindler leads to him and his father having their own face-off. Starring Jimmy Wang Yu.

programme.title: Ode to Gallantry
programme.desc: Directed by Chang cheh, this kung fu film is one of the final efforts in the 'Venoms'' genre. It features a main character who is mistaken for a clan leader.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: In veteran writer/ director Yueh Feng's most memorable martial arts movies, the luminous and lethal Shih Szu plays the title swordswoman.

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Adapted from Chiung Yao's novel, this romance depicts how a wealthy man and a sweet girl discover that they are soulmates too late in life.

programme.title: Crazy Nuts of Kung Fu
programme.desc: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to steal a huge amount of money from a warlord's home when they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The Mad Monk rushes around saving hawkers from crumbling walls and bullies, recovering stolen money and punishing a ruthless court official and his son.

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: From writer director Pan Lei comes this Chinese variation of Henry King's famous 1950's film about a persecuted swordsman.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: In Shaw Brothers' showcase for the talented Ling Yun, a young drummer hungry for fame sacrifices everything including love, for his art. Will the prize prove worth the cost?

programme.title: Na Cha and the Seven Devils
programme.desc: Little Na Cha accidentally drops 7 magical peaches onto earth, which transformed 7 animals into devils. Na Cha must hunt them all down or his father will be punished by the King of Heaven.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: A follow-up to the previous blockbuster, this 60's musical features an unemployed magician whose love life is as twisted as his tricks.

programme.title: Holy Flame of the Martial World
programme.desc: A brother and sister use the mythical yin/yang Holy Flame kung-fu technique when they seek vengeance for their dead parents.

programme.title: Moods of Love
programme.desc: How far would you go for love? Or lust? These are the questions posed in two, sinfully entertaining Sung Dynasty tales that comprise this film.

programme.title: Cabbage, cabbage, cabbage

programme.title: 5-Ingredient Recipes
programme.desc: Who said struggle meals can’t be delicious? Don’t sleep on these 5-ingredient recipes – simple weeknight meals that are anything but boring, and with a few pantry staples, you’ll have dinner on the table in no time.

programme.title: Mayo: The Secret Ingredient
programme.desc: Who knew mayo could be such a savvy secret agent? It’s a controversial condiment that can unlock the buttery, crispy, decadent codes of our favorite dishes, without leaving a trace of mayo-ness. Best of all, it’s easy to make at home!

programme.title: Warm + Cozy Winter
programme.desc: Frankie gets cozy in the Struggle kitchen with recipes that bring all the warmth, flavor and joy during the coldest days of winter. From a casual weekday dinner to a special weekend meal, these dishes are sure to keep you warm and cozy.

programme.title: A Cruciferous Delicious Time
programme.desc: No veggie family packs the same nutritious punch as the cruciferous family, and with a shelf life this long, they’ve become a fixture in Frankie’s meal rotation. These delicious and easy-to-make recipes will win everyone over in no time.

programme.title: Struggle Soup
programme.desc: Warm and hearty bowls of veggies, beans, pasta, and more, these soups will have you returning for seconds all year round. Frankie’s soup blueprints can turn everyday ingredients into extraordinary soups, with endless flavor opportunity.

programme.title: Crunchy
programme.desc: Reaching textural nirvana is never easy, but Frankie explores several ways to achieve the perfect crunch in his dishes, both savory and sweet. Add this elusive element to your recipes without adding cost to your budget.

programme.title: Struggle Sandwich
programme.desc: In a sandwich, every component plays a role. With a supporting cast of fixin’s, and Frankie’s cost-saving homemade twists, these sandwiches just might steal the show.

programme.title: Vintage
programme.desc: Frankie cooks his way back in time with his favorite vintage recipes. These oldie-but-goodie dishes are not only nostalgic and comforting, but they’ll also fill you up without costing you a pretty penny.

programme.title: Less Stress Holidays
programme.desc: The holidays are hectic enough, and with more planning, cooking and cleaning than usual, everyone wants to shop smart and save time. Frankie tackles weekday meals that will keep you organized, fed, and less stressed this season.

programme.title: Spice Is Nice
programme.desc: Flavor, flavor, flavor. Frankie shows us the way around the spice cabinet. All it takes is a couple primary dried spices to make a variety of homemade spice blends. Bonus: Frankie also tackles a monster challenge with our favorite monster guest!

programme.title: Holiday Flavors
programme.desc: The holiday season looks different this year, so why not mix things up and celebrate classic flavors in new and unexpected ways. Frankie teaches us to put a twist on all your holiday favorites, using simple ingredients for your loved ones to enjoy.

programme.title: Beans Beans Beans
programme.desc: Frankie will teach the basics of preparing beans from scratch while making super tasty recipes. Beans are the gift that keeps on giving, so don’t be scared to eat too many. Remember, they’re good for your heart.

programme.desc: Frankie takes us on a magical mushroom trip. They’re an affordable plant-based meat replacement, packed with nutritional value. We’ll learn all things mushrooms and how to make inventive, flavorful dishes that might trip you out on their awesomeness.

programme.title: Hotdishes
programme.desc: You say hotdishes, Frankie says casserole. Either way, these one-pot hotdishes are an affordable way to feed a group of people, or the family for dinner. Plus they're great to freeze for future meals!

programme.title: Frankie & Flour
programme.desc: Flour has the super power to transform into an endless variety of meals. Frankie teaches us how to make three different meals using flour as the affordable vehicle. Save money and strap on an apron. It's time to get messy in the kitchen.

programme.title: Plant-Based Budget Meals
programme.desc: Frankie busts the myth that eating plant-based is expensive. Preparing these good-for-you meals is all about eating seasonally and shopping the bulk aisle to save money on produce. It’s nutritious and great for the planet. Win-win!

programme.title: Date Night
programme.desc: Date night doesn’t have to be at an over-priced, mediocre restaurant. Frankie prepares an affordable and delicious sushi date night at home, plus tips on how to set date night ambiance at home on a struggle budget. That special someone will love it!

programme.title: Lunches for Work
programme.desc: A big way to save money is to prepare homemade lunches for work. Frankie shows us how to make five delicious lunches for the whole work week. You'll be saving money, and you might even be more productive at work after a nutritious homemade lunch!

programme.title: The Weekly Struggle Budget
programme.desc: Frankie figured out the weekly budget grocery equation so you don’t have to. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner for seven days, for a family of four, for under $150. All it takes is a little planning, meal prep, and using up leftovers in inventive ways.

programme.title: An Eggplant Extravaganza
programme.desc: Eggplant: A fruit you didn’t know was a fruit. Often underrated and overlooked, Frankie shows us how to shop for and cook this filling, delicious, cost-effective, and versatile ingredient. The days of mushy, bitter eggplant will be long gone.

programme.title: Cauliflower's Star Power
programme.desc: Cauliflower is a star and can be transformed into unexpected dishes. Plus it's delicious and nutritious! Frankie reminds us to buy dried-goods in bulk and makes a big chuck roast that stretches over three dishes.

programme.title: Food Back from the Dead
programme.desc: Stale bread, old bananas, canned food, dry foods... they've all gotten a bad wrap, but this is not the end of them yet! Don't let this stuff sit in the pantry, don't let it go to waste - Frankie encourages you to stretch further and cheaper!

When the owner goes on a trip, felines will have a great vacation at the cat hotel!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt faces one of his most challenging cases with Barbie the Basset Hound. Barbie has been at the surgery for two days, since she was hit by a car. Her jaw, elbow and shoulder were shattered. She needs extensive surgery to fix them, but she's been too ill for an anaesthetic. After 48 hours on a drip, Matt' hopes she'll be strong enough to cope with her first operation today.

programme.title: My House And Other Animals
programme.desc: Meet the modern-day Dr Doolittles with a passion for all creatures great and small: the unsung heroes of the wildlife world, whose homes have become havens for every animal imaginable.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Dogs are mans’ most loyal friends. Their well-behaved and cute appearance is very soothing to our hearts. That’s why many people choose dogs to company with their family! There are many choices for companion dogs, but today's cute pet have well-developed muscles and a fierce look on their faces. But in fact, they love to act cute, making the contrast between their personality and appearance is extremely cute!nToday's Cute Pet Coming is going to subvert everyone’s impression on them! Follow us and get to know bulldogs ​​with a fierce face and gentle heart!

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've got monkey criminals, magic and mirrors, cheeky monkeys, monkey pals, banana loving primates, baby monkeys, monkeys vs cameras, monkeys out on the town, and monkeys acting like us humans.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Inspector Herchy Boal teams up with the police to attend a property near Birmingham suspected of puppy farming. Tragically, for one puppy it was already too late, but she manages to rescue another 37 including 8 expectant mothers. Herchy discovers a range of breeds including Shih-Tzu’s, West Highland Terriers and Cavashons, but with many pups still yet to be born, how will they all get on?

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: It's three weeks since Barbie's operation to fix her shattered jaw. Her jaw's still held by the metal brace, but her leg bandage is finally off and. Matt has approved Barbie a little light exercise. There is an anxious wait for the jawbone to heal so that Barbie's metal brace can be removed. But least she can now walk.

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc: Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".nnBut they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The Japanese animated film My Neighbor Totoro, which is popular all over the world is the childhood memory of many. Totoro's classic furry body, round eyes and cute expression are very endearing. In South America, there is a kind of chinchilla that looks very similar to Totoro in the film. I heard that Taiwan now allows legal imports of these animals for breeding! Today, let’s follow the Totoro zoo owner Molly and fall in love with the soft and cute charm of this animation star!

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E06 - Terry And The Minigun
programme.desc: ¿Puedes realmente disparar una GE Minigun a mano con munición sujetada en una mochila (también visto en Depredador (1987)? Además, para una de nuestras pruebas más grandes, ¿puedes realmente talar un bosque de jungla con una Minigun? El actor Bill Duke, que coprotagonizó con Arnold Schwarzenegger en la película y cuyo personaje realizó este stunt de arma, se une a nosotros para averiguarlo. Pero primero, tenemos que construir una jungla.

programme.desc: Honoring 50 years of marriage between Her Majesty the Queen and her husband, Prince Philip of Greece and Denmark, the Duke of Edinburgh.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E08 - Operation Rocky Mountain Front
programme.desc: 在狩獵季節，野生動物管理員透過用麋鹿誘餌抓捕盜獵者，追踪闖入者並檢查狩獵標籤，保持警覺。

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E05 - Fireside Fortune
programme.desc: Utilizando sus últimas energías, los hermanos Keefer se dirigen río abajo en busca de su siguiente alijo. La marea cambia cuando finalmente logran salir de la tundra abierta y entrar en el corazón del territorio de los alces.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E06 - Now or Never
programme.desc: Con los ánimos levantados, los hermanos Keefer se disponen a avistar y acechar una manada de caribúes cercana, pero acercarse resulta más difícil de lo esperado.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E07 - Scoreless
programme.desc: Utilizando un método único para abrir una caja fuerte, Nick Wells (Robert De Niro) utiliza un soplete para cortar a través de una caja fuerte, la llena de agua y hace estallar la puerta con un pequeño dispositivo explosivo. Probamos esto, junto con los efectos de un rifle antitanque de 20 mm en una caja fuerte de la película Thunderbolt and Lightfoot.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E08 - Terry Vs Gorn
programme.desc: 特里和拉里在紐約上州的星際迷航原始系列拍攝場地進行測試。他們發現自己在USS Enterprise上，並測試柯克是否可以用竹管、鎂粉和石刀及皮革製造一門大炮。在星際迷航中它成功了，但這真的會有效嗎？

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E07 - The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: These are the the Moon's of the gas giants. Each a unique and mysterious world of its own. Some have oceans of water, geysers of Sulphur or atmospheres of plastic. Some are just now being seen at the outer rim of our solar system, all are worthy of much more scrutiny.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E08 - The Sun
programme.desc: Impulsa la maquinaria de la naturaleza; nuestro clima, fomenta y sostiene la vida en la tierra y en el mar. Cuando se pone por el Oeste, nos revela los miles de millones de estrellas hermanas que pueblan el cielo nocturno. Estudiamos nuestro Sol de cerca y, como una piedra Rosetta, puede revelarnos los secretos de todas las demás estrellas.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E04 - Elephant Country
programme.desc: Ivan joins the foremost anti-poaching team in Mozambique to bring down one particular group of poachers who have been killing local elephants for their ivory.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E27 - Diana And Sarah The Royal Wives Of Windsor Part 1
programme.desc: 作為皇室妻子，戴安娜與莎拉的生活充滿了孤獨和悲傷，儘管她們懷抱著對於為溫莎家帶來改變的殷切期望。原本該是她們"童話般"的生活，卻最終遠離了這一現實。

programme.desc: 在狩獵季節，野生動物管理員透過用麋鹿誘餌抓捕盜獵者，追踪闖入者並檢查狩獵標籤，保持警覺。

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E05 - Fireside Fortune
programme.desc: Utilizando sus últimas energías, los hermanos Keefer se dirigen río abajo en busca de su siguiente alijo. La marea cambia cuando finalmente logran salir de la tundra abierta y entrar en el corazón del territorio de los alces.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E06 - Now or Never
programme.desc: Con los ánimos levantados, los hermanos Keefer se disponen a avistar y acechar una manada de caribúes cercana, pero acercarse resulta más difícil de lo esperado.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E07 - Scoreless
programme.desc: Utilizando un método único para abrir una caja fuerte, Nick Wells (Robert De Niro) utiliza un soplete para cortar a través de una caja fuerte, la llena de agua y hace estallar la puerta con un pequeño dispositivo explosivo. Probamos esto, junto con los efectos de un rifle antitanque de 20 mm en una caja fuerte de la película Thunderbolt and Lightfoot.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E08 - Terry Vs Gorn
programme.desc: 特里和拉里在紐約上州的星際迷航原始系列拍攝場地進行測試。他們發現自己在USS Enterprise上，並測試柯克是否可以用竹管、鎂粉和石刀及皮革製造一門大炮。在星際迷航中它成功了，但這真的會有效嗎？

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E07 - The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: These are the the Moon's of the gas giants. Each a unique and mysterious world of its own. Some have oceans of water, geysers of Sulphur or atmospheres of plastic. Some are just now being seen at the outer rim of our solar system, all are worthy of much more scrutiny.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E08 - The Sun
programme.desc: Impulsa la maquinaria de la naturaleza; nuestro clima, fomenta y sostiene la vida en la tierra y en el mar. Cuando se pone por el Oeste, nos revela los miles de millones de estrellas hermanas que pueblan el cielo nocturno. Estudiamos nuestro Sol de cerca y, como una piedra Rosetta, puede revelarnos los secretos de todas las demás estrellas.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E04 - Elephant Country
programme.desc: Ivan joins the foremost anti-poaching team in Mozambique to bring down one particular group of poachers who have been killing local elephants for their ivory.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E27 - Diana And Sarah The Royal Wives Of Windsor Part 1
programme.desc: 作為皇室妻子，戴安娜與莎拉的生活充滿了孤獨和悲傷，儘管她們懷抱著對於為溫莎家帶來改變的殷切期望。原本該是她們"童話般"的生活，卻最終遠離了這一現實。

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E09 - Operation Check Point
programme.desc: 在國家的某些最隱密的地區努力保護我們珍貴的自然資源意味著工作中總是有一些有趣的事情發生。

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E07 - Cache Out
programme.desc: Con la carne roja, los hermanos Keefer consiguen por fin reponer sus agotadas energías, pero no son los únicos que buscan sobrevivir al invierno en las tierras salvajes de Alaska.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E08 - Bearing Down
programme.desc: La dura realidad del invierno se impone, y los hermanos Keefer se ven obligados a dormir con un ojo abierto mientras un oso pardo patrulla los alrededores de su campamento.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S02:E01 - Terry Down Under
programme.desc: 特里和拉里測試電影《奎格利在下方》。

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S02:E02 - Bond, Terry Bond
programme.desc: 特里和拉里對詹姆斯·邦德進行測試。

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E09 - Exo Planets
programme.desc: A medida que los científicos y astrónomos observan las estrellas cercanas con mayor fidelidad, descubren planetas, exoplanetas, mundos fuera de nuestro sistema solar. Gracias a los avances tecnológicos y a la mejora de las técnicas, los científicos descubren cada día más mundos. Los científicos calculan que podría haber hasta 40.000 millones de planetas similares a la Tierra sólo en nuestra galaxia, la Vía Láctea.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E10 - Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: El cielo nocturno es una máquina del tiempo. Cuanto más miramos hacia el Universo, más atrás en el tiempo llegamos. Lo que vemos en el cielo nocturno es sólo un pequeño porcentaje del contenido del Universo, la mayor parte es materia oscura y energía oscura sabemos que existe; sin embargo, su naturaleza se nos escapa por el momento.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E05 - Capturing the Wild
programme.desc: Después de ver la desaparición de animales salvajes en el norte de África, Ivan se une a un equipo de captura de élite para ver cómo se captura, compra y vende la vida salvaje. Este "comercio de vida salvaje" es un modelo de negocio innovador que podría cambiar por completo la cara de la conservación en África.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E28 - Diana And Sarah The Royal Wives Of Windsor Part 2
programme.desc: 威爾士公主黛安娜和約克公爵夫人莎拉均嫁入女王的大家族，處於丑聞中心卻以不同方式離開。可惜的是，黛安娜已去世，而莎拉幸存下來，重新開始。隨著時間推移，她們的奮鬥可以得到更好的理解，本紀錄片探討了這些挑戰...

programme.title: Jim Shockey's Uncharted - S01:E01 - Beginnings
programme.desc: Papua New Guinea. Meet Jim Shockey and Corey Knowlton, two contrasting characters who nevertheless share the same passion to explore and hunt the most remote and uncharted areas on planet earth. First stop: Papua New Guinea

programme.title: Savage Wild - S03:E05 - Hammer Time
programme.desc: Manny recibe la visita de un enorme tiburón martillo.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S03:E06 - Escape from the Everglades
programme.desc: Manny te muestra como caminar 10 millas fuera de los Everglades y sobrevivir en este hermoso y mortal lugar.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S03:E07 - Hunt for General Lee
programme.desc: Manny vuelve al Dead River de Florida en busca de un enorme caimán de 14 pies.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S03:E08 - Manny's Confession
programme.desc: Manny revive un feroz ataque de caimán.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E01 - Man Eating Crocodiles of Zimbabwe
programme.desc: Mario takes a huge gamble by rafting along Africa's most dangerous river, the Zambezi, heading towards Lake Reba. But he ends up face-to-face with some of the largest and most fearsome man-eating crocodiles around.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E02 - Namibian Desert Oryx
programme.desc: Mario heard from some locals about a strange-looking creature deep in the Namibian desert. So, he decided to brave the sweltering heat in a hot air balloon to track down the oryx.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E03 - Kalahari Bushmen
programme.desc: In the Kalahari desert, there’s an old tribe living off the land. Mario spends a week working hard to gather food to share with them.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E04 - Untouched Atolls
programme.desc: Just off the coast of Africa is a strip of 115 islands called the Seychelles. Mario educates his audience as to how to fish for reef species. Out of know where he even attempts to swim with a sailfish.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E05 - Montana Elk Part 1
programme.desc: En busca de alces, Laramy ha hecho el largo viaje a caballo en lo profundo de estas montañas de Montana. Ahora sólo tiene que ponerse a tiro de uno de estos enormes toros.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E06 - Alaska Trapping
programme.desc: Laramy pone a prueba sus habilidades con las trampas en los parajes salvajes de Alaska. Puede ser diferente, pero no menos gratificante.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E07 - Montana Elk Part 2
programme.desc: Laramy caza alces en Montana y acecha a un enorme toro. Con sólo su arco y flecha, Laramy dispara y demuestra su valía. Pero hacer el disparo es sólo la mitad de la batalla.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E08 - Texas Aoudad
programme.desc: Sasquatch has made the long journey south, to Texas, where he will hunt the aoudad with his Hawken rifle.
